title: Share Trading Policy

tiers.name: Restricted Persons
tiers.description: The whole scope of the policy: directors and officers; Senior Executives and their Closely Connected Persons; employees; contractors and consultants; and any entities controlled by or otherwise associated with any of the foregoing.

tiers.name: Directors
tiers.description: Directors of the Flight Centre Group; distinguished for the enhanced margin loan/hedging vesting ban and for the duty to notify the Company Secretary of any change in their interest in Flight Centre Securities as soon as possible.

tiers.name: Senior Executives
tiers.description: Persons having authority and responsibility for planning, directing and controlling the activities of the entity, directly or indirectly, including any director; distinguished for the enhanced margin loan/hedging vesting ban and the interest-change notification duty.

tiers.name: Closely Connected Persons
tiers.description: A spouse or de facto spouse of a Senior Executive; a child under 18 of a Senior Executive; and a trust controlled by a Senior Executive or by such a spouse or child. Subject to the same enhanced margin loan/hedging vesting ban as Directors and Senior Executives.

definitions.hedging_definition: hedging or otherwise entering into a contract with the purpose of securing a profit or avoiding a loss by reference to movements in the price of Flight Centre Securities

windows.start_anchor: announcement to ASX of Flight Centre's half year results, full year results, AGM results, or profit guidance

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: The Company Secretary may open an Ad Hoc Trading Window outside a normal Trading Window by notifying Restricted Persons directly by email with its duration, and may also prohibit certain or all Restricted Persons from Dealing during a Trading Window or Ad Hoc Trading Window, notified directly by email. Confidentiality of a prohibition is not addressed.

rules.detail: Securities/Flight Centre Securities are expressly defined to include options, warrant contracts, contracts for difference and other derivatives. No pre-clearance is required for dealing within an open Trading Window absent inside information; dealing outside a window needs Company Secretary approval (see Clearance).

financing_disclosure: Restricted Persons: immediate notification to the Company Secretary of any margin lending, other securities lending, charge/lien/encumbrance, or hedging arrangement, where the securities subject represent 5% or more of Flight Centre's issued capital; the Company Secretary then informs the Board.

exemption_authority: The Company Secretary may approve dealing outside a Trading Window in exceptional circumstances (extreme financial hardship, or other circumstances considered exceptional by the Chairman or, if they involve the Chairman, the Managing Director); a granted approval lasts 7 days. The Company Secretary may also open Ad Hoc Trading Windows or prohibit dealing during a Trading Window/Ad Hoc Trading Window for certain or all Restricted Persons, notified directly by email.

bespoke_clauses.clause: where the Flight Centre Securities subject to such arrangements represent 5% or more of Flight Centre's issued capital.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A funded collar over less than 5% of Flight Centre's issued capital escapes even the notification duty for margin lending, encumbrance and hedging; above that threshold it triggers mandatory immediate notification to the Company Secretary, who informs the Board, but this is disclosure only, not a veto.

bespoke_clauses.topic: vesting-based ban targets directors and executives specifically
bespoke_clauses.clause: Directors, Senior Executives and Closely Connected Persons are prohibited from entering into margin loans, hedging or any other arrangement that would have the effect of limiting their exposure to risk in relation to an element of their remuneration that: i. has not vested ... or ii. has vested ... but remains subject to a holding lock.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The very population a bank would target for a funded collar faces an absolute, non-waivable ban on both the loan and hedge legs until the shares are both vested and free of any holding lock.

bespoke_clauses.topic: no general pre-clearance once vested and unrestricted
bespoke_clauses.clause: Restricted Persons may only Deal in Flight Centre Securities during Trading Windows
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Once vested and unrestricted, a Director or Senior Executive can enter derivative or financing arrangements within an open Trading Window without needing case-by-case prior approval, only the 5% notification duty if applicable - comparatively permissive relative to policies requiring approval for every dealing.

bespoke_clauses.topic: outside-window approval covers any dealing, not just disposals
bespoke_clauses.clause: Restricted Persons are prohibited from trading in Flight Centre Securities at times outside the Trading Windows, unless otherwise approved by the Company Secretary in exceptional circumstances.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Unlike policies that limit out-of-window relief to sales, this approval (7-day validity) could in principle extend to entering a collar or its financing outside a window, provided exceptional circumstances and no inside information.

summary: A funded collar is achievable once the underlying Flight Centre shares are vested and no longer subject to a holding lock, but is completely blocked before then for Directors, Senior Executives and their Closely Connected Persons. On unvested or vested-but-locked remuneration, margin loans, hedging and any other risk-limiting arrangement are absolutely prohibited with no consent route. Once vested and unrestricted, both the derivative legs and the secured loan (captured under margin lending / encumbrance) can be entered within an open 30-day Trading Window (following half-year results, full-year results, AGM results or profit guidance) without needing prior approval, provided the person holds no inside information; the only additional requirement is immediate notification to the Company Secretary, who informs the Board, once the shares involved reach 5% of Flight Centre's issued capital. Dealing outside a Trading Window is otherwise barred unless the Company Secretary grants a 7-day exceptional-circumstances approval. Overall, both legs of a funded collar can proceed on vested, unrestricted shares timed to an open window, subject only to a disclosure trigger at the 5% threshold, with no veto right reserved to the Company in the policy itself.
